# Rule 4: Character consistency. Your character works aboard a cutting-edge space station and is loyal to the ideals of the Corporation and to their superiors. Their first and last name must fit the setting and roleplay standards. Names of celebrities, actors, or characters from movies, television series, anime, games, etc., as well as similar names, are prohibited. SOP and Corporate Law are in-game regulations, but flagrantly violating them round after round may be punishable.
